# Status reference

Every class in `assets/scripts/status/`, from its doc comments. The overview is in [README.md](README.md).

- [StatThreshold](#statthreshold)
- [StatusManager](#statusmanager)

## StatThreshold

`res://assets/scripts/status/StatThreshold.gd`, extends [`Resource`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_resource.html)

A level on a stat that sends an event when the stat's current value falls to it or below (pawn spec 16.8).

A [`Stat`](../stats/REFERENCE.md#stat) lists its thresholds (`Stat.thresholds`); `StatusManager.change_current()` sends the event of each one a change crosses on the way down, through the pawn (`Pawn.send_event()`). Health's defaults: at 0 `event.health.depleted` (Death starts), at 25% of its max `event.health.low`.

### Settings and properties

- `event: StringName` = `&""`: The event it sends, an event tag such as `event.health.low`.
- `at_or_below: float` = `0.0`: The level: an amount, or with `fraction_of_max` a share of the stat's max (0.25 is a quarter).
- `fraction_of_max: bool` = `false`: On: `at_or_below` is a share of the stat's max value; off: an amount.

### Functions

- `level_for(max_value: float) -> float`: The level as an amount, for a stat whose max is this.

## StatusManager

`res://assets/scripts/status/StatusManager.gd`, extends [`Node`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_node.html)

A pawn's status: its stats and the effects on it, in one component (pawn spec 16.8).

Stats are [`Stat`](../stats/REFERENCE.md#stat) child nodes, found by name; a missing stat is never an error (`get_value()` gives the fallback). Effects ([`Effect`](../effects/REFERENCE.md#effect)) are applied with `apply_effect()`: instant ones run at once; over-time ones go in a rolled-back active list that keeps the tick each ends and the tick of its next period (deadlines: nothing counts down), and all end when the pawn dies. Do-once parts run on the authority only; modifiers work on every machine. Every change to a stat's current value goes through `change_current()`, which sends the stat's threshold events through the pawn (`Pawn.send_event()`) when a change crosses one: Health at 0 sends `event.health.depleted`. Health taken by an effect sends `event.damage.taken` with its source.

```gdscript
pawn.status_manager.get_value(&"MoveSpeed", 5.0)         # a stat's value, or the fallback without it
pawn.status_manager.change_current(&"Health", -20, who)  # the server: kept between 0 and its max; sends threshold events
pawn.status_manager.apply_effect(effect, source)         # source: who applied it (memory, lifesteal), or null
pawn.status_manager.remove_with_tag(Tags.EFFECT.DEBUFF)  # a cleanse
```

### Settings and properties

- `resistances: Dictionary[StringName, float]` = `{}`: This pawn's resistances by effect tag: 0.25 takes a quarter off harmful effects, 1 or more ignores them, negative is a weakness.
  
  A tag counts for every effect inside it, and they add up (0.2 effect.damage.elemental + 0.3 effect.damage.elemental.fire = 0.5 against fire).
- `max_active_effects: int` = `16`: The most over-time effects this pawn can have at once. A new one past this is refused.
- `active_effects: PackedInt64Array`: The active list, five numbers per effect (see `STRIDE`); rolled back and sent in snapshots. Read it with `get_active_effects()`.
- `pawn: Pawn` = `null`: The pawn it belongs to (its parent), or null outside a pawn.
- `version: int` = `1`: Goes up by one whenever a stat's value changes, or a stat is added or removed (not when a current value such as Health changes). An ability that keeps stat values reads them again only when this has changed (pawn spec 15.2).

### Signals

- `effect_applied(effect: Effect, application: EffectApplication)`: Sent when an effect is applied, on every machine that applies it (effectors only ran if this is the authority).
- `effect_ended(effect: Effect)`: Sent when an over-time effect ends or is removed.

### Constants

- `HEALTH = &"Health"`: The name of the Health stat. A pawn without a stat of this name can't be hurt or die from damage.
- `DETECTABILITY = &"Detectability"`: The name of the Detectability stat: how easy the pawn is for AI to see (1 normal, 0 invisible). `detectability_of()` reads it, and it's copied into the pawn table for the sensing job (`Stat.table_column`).
- `STRIDE = 5`: Numbers per entry in `active_effects`; ID, ENDS_AT, NEXT_PERIOD_AT, STACKS and SOURCE are their positions in an entry.
- `ID = 0`
- `ENDS_AT = 1`: the tick it ends
- `NEXT_PERIOD_AT = 2`: the tick its effectors run again; -1 without a period
- `STACKS = 3`
- `SOURCE = 4`
- `UNTIL_REMOVED = 9223372036854775807`: What ENDS_AT holds for an effect that lasts until removed (`Effect.lasts_until_removed`).

### Functions

- `detectability_of(of_pawn: Node) -> float` *(static)*: How easy this pawn is for AI to see: its Detectability stat's value, 1 without one (pawn spec 10.4). Effects change it through the stat; game rules for stealth belong in a GameMode module.
- `get_health() -> float`: How much Health the pawn has now, or 0 without a Health stat.
- `get_current(stat_name: StringName, fallback: float = 0.0) -> float`: How much a stat that changes during play has now, or the fallback if there's no such stat.
- `change_current(stat_name: StringName, amount: float, source: Node = null, cause: Object = null) -> float`: Adds to a stat that changes during play (negative takes away), kept between 0 and its value; returns the new amount (0: no such stat). Crossing one of its `Stat.thresholds` sends that event at once, from `source` about `cause`. Server only: clients get it in snapshots, and a value a snapshot or rollback restores sends nothing.
- `fill_current(stat_name: StringName) -> void`: Fills a stat that changes during play to its value (a revive, a level start). Sends no threshold events.
- `get_value(stat_name: StringName, fallback: float = 0.0) -> float`: The stat's value right now, or fallback if this pawn has no such stat.
- `get_stat(stat_name: StringName) -> Stat`: The Stat node, or null if there's none with that name.
- `has_stat(stat_name: StringName) -> bool`: True if this pawn has a stat with that name.
- `get_stat_names() -> StringName[]`: Every stat's name.
- `apply_effect(effect: Effect, source: Pawn = null, source_ability: AbilityBase = null, hit: HitInfo = null) -> bool`: Applies an effect to this pawn. source is who applied it, or null; source_ability and hit are handed to its parts. Returns false if refused: dead, invulnerable, immune, the list full, or IGNORE stacking.
- `apply_effects(effects: Effect[], source: Pawn = null, source_ability: AbilityBase = null, hit: HitInfo = null) -> void`: Applies several, in order, stopping if the pawn dies.
- `take_hit(hit: HitInfo) -> void`: Called by the AbilityManager when a hit lands, on the authority: the hit's effects, from its attacker. Fills in hit.damage_dealt.
- `tick_effects() -> void`: The pawn calls this once per tick, before its abilities run, while the list has something in it: runs the periods that came due and ends the effects whose time is up. Nothing is done between deadlines.
- `can_sleep() -> bool`: True if the pawn can sleep (pawn spec 15.3): no effects, and nothing waiting to be worked out.
- `has_effect(effect: Effect) -> bool`: True while this over-time effect is on the pawn.
- `get_stacks(effect: Effect) -> int`: How many stacks of it the pawn has: 0 if none.
- `get_ticks_left(effect: Effect) -> int`: Ticks it has left: 0 if it isn't on the pawn.
- `get_active_effects() -> Dictionary[]`: Every active effect, for readouts: [{"effect": Effect or null, "ends_at", "ticks_left", "stacks", "source": Pawn or null}], oldest first.
- `remove_effect(effect: Effect) -> void`: Removes an over-time effect, if it's on the pawn.
- `remove_with_tag(tag: StringName) -> void`: Removes every active effect with this effect tag, or a tag inside it: remove_with_tag(Tags.EFFECT.DEBUFF) is a cleanse.
- `remove_all() -> void`: Removes everything. Done when the pawn dies (it listens for the AbilityManager's died).
- `resistance_to(effect: Effect) -> float`: This pawn's resistance to an effect (see `resistances`), not capped: 1 or more means immune.
- `ability_bonus(ability: AbilityBase, number: int) -> int`: What held AbilityModifiers add to this ability's number now (AbilityModifier.Number). The AbilityManager asks.
- `get_parries() -> ParryModifier[]`: The parries held now ([`ParryModifier`](../effects/REFERENCE.md#parrymodifier)), for the hit ability to ask. Don't change the list.
- `has_ability_bonuses() -> bool`: True if any held AbilityModifier changes ability numbers now. Lets the AbilityManager skip asking.
